system.description:
This is a special song an Elf can sing to a door or gate. The singer may ask one gate in his presence, “What lies beyond?” and be answered.

Obstacle: See Description. Fence gates, Ob 1. Cabin doors, Ob 2. House doors, Ob 3. Doors of a great hall, Ob 4. Fortress gate, Ob 5. Castle gate, Ob 6. City gates, Ob 7. Gates of the realm, Ob 8.

Actions: 25 x the obstacle

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 144
